title: My laptop isn't charging even though it's plugged in
description: My device is plugged into the charger, but the battery percentage keeps dropping.

worklogs.description: Determined the charging adapter was 45W instead of 65W, insufficient.
Provided a spare 90W adapter, the battery started charging.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The old 45W adapter wasn't enough for your device, I replaced it with a 90W one. It's charging now, you can check.

resolutionNote: Adapter upgraded from 45W to 90W. The device's charging speed is normal, it reached 100% within 1 hour.
